name: @cesium-ai/sandbox-cesium
description: Browser-executed QuickJS-wasm sandbox that runs already-verified CesiumJS code directly against a live Viewer's real API surface, plus client-side execution guardrails (entity cap, call rate limiter). The execution half of the Code Mode pipeline that @cesium-ai/codegen-cesium generates and statically verifies; frontend-only (depends on cesium + quickjs-emscripten), never imported server-side.
